data.one_liner: Paginate Cloud Firestore and Firebase Realtime Database with live updates.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like FirestorePagination and RealtimeDBPagination to handle scrolling-based data pagination and live updates from Firebase backends.
use_when: You need to display paginated lists from Cloud Firestore or Firebase Realtime Database.
You want automatic handling of infinite scrolling and data updates.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase as your backend.
You prefer implementing custom pagination logic using scroll controllers.
strengths: Simplifies pagination for both Cloud Firestore and Firebase Realtime Database
Supports live updates and real-time changes
Low resource usage with a maximum of two stream listeners
data.setup_notes: Requires configured Firebase in your Flutter application.
